Subject: Redwood estimate + deck attached — quick confirmation and 15m walkthrough?

Hi Jordan — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for taking the time to walk through Blue Harbor's inference needs. I captured a short recap and attached a tailored pricing deck. Would you mind confirming you received it? Happy to run through the assumptions live (15 minutes) if helpful.

Recap from today's discovery:
- Workload: real-time embeddings + chat assist (user-facing)
- Performance target: p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token responses
- Expected steady-state: ~150 qps, burst to 500 qps during peak
- Data residency: US-only for now, possible EU expansion in H2

Recommended configuration (high level):
- Dedicated pool with mixed model routing (gpt-large quantized variant for cost/latency balance)
- KV prefix caching for chat sessions to reduce token cost

Attached: redwood_pricing_deck_2026.pdf (estimate summary + configuration options)

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm the deck landed in your inbox?
2) If helpful I can walk through the estimate and call out areas to tighten cost (15 minutes) — proposed slots below.

Proposed 15-minute windows (Pacific):
- Tue 11/16 10:00–10:15
- Tue 11/16 14:30–14:45
- Wed 11/17 09:00–09:15

If none of those work, share a time that does.

Thanks again,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
